findings.text: §12 cites health review run `r-20261012T210306162650-review-code-46f5fd5115fb`, but no run directory with that id exists; the run that produced the cited report and the `treatment names no write path` refusal is `r-20261012T210316296049-review-code-46f5fd5115fb` (its manifest `run_id` and directory name), and only the reaching `code-review.json` carries the shorter id

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — the run id §12 cites resolves to no run (see FINDING below); every other anchor resolves: `parse_health_review` is at reckon/crew/review.py:1036, the refusal text matches `code-review.json`'s `store_error`, the named write paths `reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py` and `reckon/crew/obligations.py` exist, and the plan slug `the-review-loop-runs-without-hand-steps` resolves under docs/plans/.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §12's done-when names three concrete cases (the delivered report parses with write paths `reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py` and `reckon/crew/obligations.py` and delta -18; a wrapped FINDING keeps class and whole text; a one-line report is unchanged) and a negative control ("reads lines alone again, and the wrapped-treatment case must then fail").
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the negative control "is logged under the run directory" (~/.config/reckon/crew/runs/<run>/), a durable path that survives the run, not a node-local temporary.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §12 introduces no code symbol, comment or filename carrying a plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag; its test and fixture paths (`test_a_wrapped_health_record_parses.py`, a fixture under tests/fixtures/) are named by what they exercise.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated root cause matches the evidence (the delivered report wraps its TREATMENT so `WRITE_PATHS:` moves past the first line, `_review_text_lines` yields one stripped line at a time, and the store recorded exactly `HealthReviewError: treatment names no write path`), the mechanism (join non-blank, non-record, non-heading lines to the record they continue) reproduces the done-when on the cited report, and the mechanism runs on the real code path — `parse_health_review` is called by the store at reckon/crew/plan_review.py:2129, not only by tests.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §12 carries one deliverable (join continuation lines in one parser) and one measure ("a wrapped health review record still stores").
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §12 declares no dependency it needs: its only code change is to `parse_health_review` (reckon/crew/review.py:1036), installed by the done §5 and reached through the store at reckon/crew/plan_review.py:2129, so no depends-on is required and none of its declared relationships points at the wrong node.
